summary: conv-context-next preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: conv-context-next@1.0.6 declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...zip), extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against the shipped `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated JavaScript blob (a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, a rotated string/number constant array `n7gIxM=[...]` with a shift-based decoder `WV8StW`, and hex-mangled identifiers) whose contents are opaque. The package advertises itself as a conversation-context helper library, a purpose that does not require fetching a second language runtime or executing an opaque payload at install. The alternate-runtime step causes the payload to execute outside Node-based tooling, and the obfuscation prevents inspection of what the payload does on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
